text:
lucy: Recap from vendor pilot call: they want SSO + queryable audit logs in MVP and said pilot contract hinges on it. timeline request: move pilot 2.5 weeks earlier.

dan: That's a big ask on audit logs. It touches storage, search index, and retention policy.

priya: High-level options:
A) Stick to MVP baseline (SSO only). Push audit logs to v1.
B) Accept audit logs into MVP (basic 30d indexed logs) -> adds ~3w and infra.

nate: If we pick B we need a formal timeline reset and to trade scope. Recommend swapping out UX polish + noncustomer telemetry for the 3-week buffer.

lucy: Sales is pushing hard; they say LOI likely if we commit to B. But they won't sign without a firm estimate.

dan: Quick tech delta for B:
```
infra: +1 storage node, +1 search replica
cost: ~~$7-10k/mo infra
eng: +3w (1.2 FTE equivalent)
```

priya: Compliance note: indexing logs triggers retention policy and legal review for their EU customers. Add legal in the loop now.

acct-bot: Reminder: usage credit policy requires written LOI before infra spend.

nate: Action items: @dan produce A/B cutlist with time/cost/risk bullets by EOD. @lucy confirm LOI probability and any legal constraints. Meet tomorrow 11:00 PT to decide.

lucy: Also add a short blurb for sales negotiation: we can offer audit logs in MVP if customer signs LOI that covers 3 months of retention infra. keeps expectations clear.

priya: +1. If LOI not firm, we offer phased promise: SSO in MVP, audit logs delivered early v1 within 8 weeks of LOI.

dan: Got it. I'll post the cutlists.

nate: Devops note: auth canary scheduled 2025-10-10 01:00 UTC  ensure no overlapping migrations for the chosen cut.

lucy: Great. reconvene tomorrow 11:00. :thumbsup:
